text:
emily: Quick follow-up from today's runtime roadmap segment. A few pointed asks for docs/PM/infra: (1) sprint assignment for sparse-attn vs quant-kernels; (2) what exactly does Hosted default KV eviction look like now? LRU only or something hybrid?; (3) a tiny copy-paste config showing conservative batching defaults + tenant override. Keep replies short so I can paste to the notes. @sam @raj @kevin
sam: Sparse-attn landed in the sprint backlog but behind one correctness test (aiming for canary next week). Quant-kernels (4-bit path) kicked off in planning and are on sprint+1.
raj: Hosted KV: default is plain LRU for now. We're shipping a "weighted-LRU" prototype but it's opt-in per-tenant until we validate memory churn.
kevin: Ops note: p99 noise still tracks large single-request sequences and cold-starts. I'll add a trace tag `kernel_warm=false` for easier filtering.
dina: Can infra drop a minimal config block we can paste into docs showing defaults + override? PM needs copy-ready.
sam: Paste-ready YAML (conservative):
```
runtime_defaults:
  batching:
    batch_ms: 15
    max_batch_tokens: 3072
    controller: percentile-95  # runtime reduces batch_ms if p95 exceeds slo
  kv_cache:
    policy: LRU
    tenant_overrides: true
    weighted_lru_enabled: false
  kernel_flags:
    sparse_attn: feature-gated
    quant_path: enabled-next-sprint
  tail_latency_slo_ms: 180
```
maria: PM ask: can infra include a rough cost delta row (batch_ms 10 -> 20) in the CSV? Sales wants a single percent estimate.
aoife: I'll run a quick cost sweep tomorrow morning across chat baseline and post a small table to the ticket.
raj: Note: weighted-LRU helps for mixed tenant footprints but we need at least 48h stable traffic to validate evictions. That's why it's opt-in.
emily: Good. Can someone post a 2-line summary for the all-hands notes with owners and ETA? One sentence per item.
dina: I'll file a doc ticket DOC-9450 and add owners: Sam (kernel timing) EOD, Aoife (cost numbers) Tue AM, Raj (Dedicated sizing + weighted-LRU follow-up) Thu.
canary-bot: canary-plan: kernel-v11.1 scheduled canary window 2026-04-02T01:00:00Z -> 2026-04-02T03:00:00Z. Gating: CI perf green + rollout smoke passed.
sam: I'll drop a 2-line note here by EOD with sprint bullets and owners.
kevin: I'll ensure CI perf job includes the new p95 controller test and confirm pre-canary.
maria: Thanks all 44d This will let PMs finalize customer guidance. If you want to opt out of follow-ups, say so here.
aoife: staying on for cost numbers.
raj: I'll prepare a short note on when weighted-LRU can be promoted from opt-in to default.
emily: Thanks everyone, I'll publish the notes once Sam posts the 2-line summary.
